messages:
omar: Quick sync — I'm rolling an experiment for graded KV eviction + a soft-throttle gating to reduce hard 429 spikes. Goal: free KV earlier and let low-priority requests be deferred instead of rejected.
maya: Nice. high-level gating rules?
omar: short version: keep token_budget_target per worker, evict once occupancy > 60%, and apply a probabilistic soft-defer between 80%-95% occupancy. Also add a tiny grace window to avoid oscillation.
omar: config I'm testing:
```
admission:
  token_target: 1200
  kv_evict_at: 0.6
  grace_ms: 200
  soft_reject:
    start_at: 0.8
    max_prob: 0.8
    fallback: enqueue_deferred
```
ryan: ran canary for 10k reqs — p95 latency down ~8%, p99 ~flat. saw a micro-regression ~50-60ms at medium concurrency (30-50 reqs/host).
jen: Observed increased KV evictions causing more KV-miss kernel switches in profiler — kernel selection churn might be adding that 50-60ms.
omar: Right — evicting cold entries is fine, but we shouldn't evict hot prefixes. I'll add a hotness penalty so hot KV keys are exempt until their access decay passes keep_hot_factor.
omar: new knob: keep_hot_factor = 0.85 (lower = evict more aggressively).
maya: Safety nets? If this ends up raising CPU or cost we should auto-rollback.
omar: Agreed. thresholds: cpu_util +10% -> rollback, p99 latency x2 -> rollback, cost_per_token +15% -> toggle to smaller quantized model.
perf-bot: Canary deploy started: 5% traffic us-west-2. Live dashboard: https://internal/perf/2734567890 (internal-only).
deploy-bot: canary scheduled and pushed to rollout service at 2734567905.
perf-bot: Quick snapshot: p95 improved, p99 stable, KV-eviction-rate up ~1.9x.
ryan: Also noticed queue length oscillates every ~30s on the host under bursty arrivals — admission hysteresis might be too tight (we're reacting too fast).
jen: If kernel selection thrashes when KV-miss increases, we should couple eviction with kernel-hint smoothing (hold kernel hint for 1s after switch) or increase batch size slightly during transitions.
omar: Good call. Let's try increasing hysteresis window to 500ms and add a 1s kernel-hint hold on canary.
omar: example log line we've been seeing:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] admit: client=req-xyz tokens=56 kv_hit=false action=soft-defer prob=0.42
```
maya: I'll run the cost simulator across 24h traces with the new policy to estimate token-cost delta.
jen: I'll run a profiler capturing: kernel-switch-rate, batch-size distribution, and per-batch KV-miss ratio.
ryan: I'll tweak hysteresis to 500ms and observe queue tail during synthetic bursts.
omar: Action items: jen = profile kernel-switch impact, ryan = hysteresis tweak + synthetic bursts, maya = cost sim, I'll update keep_hot_factor and deploy canary. Reconvene 2pm PT. :thumbsup:
